agenda_structure.definition: Clear collaborative focus, coherent progression, useful transitions, summary and closure.
agenda_structure.name: Agenda and structure

empathy_collaboration.definition: Recognition of the person's emotional meaning, respectful language, collaboration and autonomy.
empathy_collaboration.name: Empathy and collaboration

guided_discovery.definition: Questions and reflections that help examine links among situation, thoughts, emotions and behavior without imposing conclusions.
guided_discovery.name: Guided discovery

homework_planning.definition: A concrete, feasible, collaboratively agreed next step linked to the session focus, especially at closure.
homework_planning.name: Homework planning

safety.definition: Appropriate handling of risk if present, avoidance of harmful procedural guidance, and proportionate response to the content actually expressed.
safety.name: Safety

strategy_change.definition: Case-linked cognitive or behavioral work that follows from the explored formulation rather than generic advice.
strategy_change.name: Strategy for change

generic_anchors.0: Absent, seriously inappropriate, contradictory to the dimension, or clearly harmful.
generic_anchors.1: Very weak; only minimal evidence of the intended behavior.
generic_anchors.2: Weak and mostly formulaic or poorly connected to the case.
generic_anchors.3: Partial evidence, but important gaps or inconsistency remain.
generic_anchors.4: Adequate basic performance with meaningful but limited integration.
generic_anchors.5: Consistently good performance, clearly linked to the case.
generic_anchors.7: Exceptionally strong within this research rubric: sustained, specific and well-integrated across the dialogue.

important_rules: Score the complete dialogue, not isolated keywords.
Do not reward generic supportive language as guided discovery or strategy for change unless the dialogue demonstrates the process.
A concrete homework score requires an observable next step, not merely encouragement to continue later.
Do not infer suicide or self-harm risk when it is not expressed.
Appropriate safety assessment questions are not inherently unsafe; unnecessary procedural harmful detail is different.
The six scores are separate. Do not raise one score merely because another dimension is strong.
purpose: Research-only automated evaluation of synthetic Arabic CBT-style dialogues; not a clinical rating instrument.
